caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and a single nori sheet resting atop. Served in a white bowl with blue trim, it sits on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: The table is a smooth, reddish-brown wooden surface with subtle grain patterns and slight reflections.
Chashu pork slices show tender, pale pink meat with glossy, caramelized edges and visible fat marbling.
The nori seaweed is dark, glossy, and irregularly shaped with a slightly rough, textured surface.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with blue rim and subtle pattern, smooth surface, slightly glossy finish.
